problem:
What is the range of the function $f(x)=\frac{2}{x-7}-4\,?$

worked_solution:
A transformed reciprocal function of the form

$$
f(x)=\frac{a}{bx+c}+d
$$

has the horizontal asymptote $y=d,$ and therefore, its range is

$$
f(x)\in (-\infty ,d)\cup (d,\infty ).
$$

In our case, $d=-4.$ Therefore, the horizontal asymptote is $y=-4,$ and the range of the function is

$$
f(x)\in (-\infty ,-4)⋃(-4,\infty ).
$$
